component.name: Quire
component.summary: Notes, day planner and school timetable

description.p: Quire keeps your weekly school timetable, a day planner, homework and exams, and your notes in one place. Everything is stored locally on your computer.

ul.li: Today: a timeline of classes and events, tasks due, and day notes
Week: a colour-coded timetable; open a lesson's notes or add homework from any class
Coursework: homework, assignments, readings and exams grouped by when they are due
Notes: Markdown notes with search, course filing, pinning and autosave

description.p: First release: day planner, weekly timetable, coursework tracker and Markdown notes.
